title: Head of ERP Product Design & Functional Architecture
description:
Head of ERP Product Design & Functional Architecture

**Company:** Distinct Infotech Solutions  
**Location:** Kochi, Kerala | **Work Mode:** WFO  
**Experience:** 7–10+ Years | **Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **Head of ERP Product Design & Functional Architecture** to lead the functional design and architecture of complex ERP systems and enterprise applications.

This is not a conventional UI/UX leadership role. It combines product thinking, ERP domain knowledge, business process expertise, functional architecture, technical understanding, and client-facing leadership.

The role will lead a multidisciplinary team of UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, and Technical Documentation Writers to translate business requirements into scalable functionality, integrated workflows, and implementation-ready specifications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. ERP Product Strategy & Functional Design**

* Lead functional design and product experience across ERP modules.
* Translate business requirements into scalable features, workflows, and business rules.
* Ensure consistency across modules and identify functional gaps or process inefficiencies.
* Evaluate requirements based on business value, feasibility, scalability, and maintainability.

**2. Functional Architecture & Workflow Design**

* Design multi-module ERP architecture covering Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Sales, Inventory, HR, CRM, and Operations.
* Define module relationships, data flows, transaction lifecycles, validations, permissions, and dependencies.
* Design end-to-end workflows, approval hierarchies, notifications, exception handling, and automated processes.
* Collaborate with Engineering to ensure functional designs are technically feasible and scalable.

**3. API & System Integration**

* Define functional API and integration requirements in collaboration with Engineering.
* Document data mappings, API operations, validations, dependencies, and error-handling scenarios.
* Review integration specifications for functional completeness and consistency.

**4. UI/UX & Business Analysis Leadership**

* Lead UI/UX Designers and guide wireframes, prototypes, user journeys, and design systems.
* Lead Business Analysts in preparing functional requirements, user stories, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
* Review and approve functional specifications and designs before development handoff.
* Ensure requirements cover business rules, exceptions, dependencies, and edge cases.

**5. Product Documentation**

* Lead Technical Documentation Writers and establish documentation standards.
* Ensure preparation and maintenance of PRDs, functional specifications, API documentation, process diagrams, and user guides.
* Maintain requirements traceability and a single source of truth for approved product functionality.

**6. Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead client discovery sessions, requirements workshops, and design walkthroughs.
* Understand business challenges and translate them into functional solutions.
* Manage client expectations, clarify scope, and document functional decisions.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, QA, Implementation, Sales, and other stakeholders.

**7. Product vs. Customization Decisions**

* Evaluate requirements and classify them as core product, configurable, integration-based, client-specific customization, deferred, or rejected.
* Assess business value, technical feasibility, development effort, and long-term maintenance impact.
* Ensure customizations do not compromise product scalability, consistency, or upgradeability.

**8. Team Leadership & Decision-Making**

* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of UI/UX Designers, Business Analysts, and Technical Documentation Writers.
* Allocate resources, establish quality standards, and manage priorities.
* Make independent functional decisions and resolve cross-functional issues.
* Escalate strategic, contractual, or high-impact decisions to senior management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong experience in ERP and multi-module enterprise product design.
* Expertise in business process mapping, workflow design, and functional architecture.
* Proficiency in PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Functional understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, SQL, and data relationships.
* Experience with Figma or equivalent wireframing and prototyping tools.
* Proficiency in Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum and software development lifecycle.
* Excellent client communication, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage stakeholders.

**Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA / PG preferred.
* 7–10+ years of relevant experience in ERP, enterprise software, product design, functional architecture, or business systems analysis.
* Minimum 2–3 years of team leadership or ownership of significant product design initiatives.
* Proven experience in client-facing requirements discovery and enterprise product development.
* Practical understanding of API integrations, data flows, and system dependencies.

**Preferred Skills & Certifications**

* Experience in banking, finance, accounting, payments, or enterprise business applications.
* Knowledge of BPMN, UML, Swagger/OpenAPI, and Postman.
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS, approval workflows, and audit requirements.
* CBAP / CCBA, CSPO, SAFe Product Owner, BPMN / UML, or relevant ERP certifications.

**What We Are Looking For**

A product-minded functional leader who can understand complex business processes, design scalable ERP functionality, lead multidisciplinary teams, and make independent decisions while ensuring product quality, usability, and long-term maintainability.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹200,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in functional architecture, business analysis, or ERP product development?
* Are you an immediate joiner?

Experience:

* product design: 7 years (Required)
* functional architecture: 7 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Title: Content Writer

**Company:** Wellcaza School of Health Sciences (under Wellcaza Hospital Pvt Limited)  
**Location:** Elamakkara, Kochi, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 0–2 Years  
**Salary:** ₹12,000–₹20,000 per month

Job Description

Wellcaza School of Health Sciences is looking for a creative, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented **Content Writer**  to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a passion for writing, storytelling, and digital marketing, with the ability to create engaging content for social media, websites, blogs, and marketing campaigns.

Freshers with strong writing skills and a creative mindset are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

* Create engaging and persuasive content for social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
* Write creative captions, short-form content, and scripts for Instagram Reels and promotional videos.
* Develop blogs, website content, SEO-friendly articles, and educational content.
* Create compelling marketing copy for advertisements, brochures, posters, and promotional campaigns.
* Draft email campaigns, WhatsApp messages, admission promotions, and student engagement content.
* Adapt content for different audiences, platforms, and communication objectives.
* Support branding, digital marketing, student recruitment, and institutional promotional activities.
* Proofread and edit content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and grammatical correctness.

Required Skills

* Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Creativity in storytelling, copywriting, and promotional content.
* Basic understanding of SEO, keywords, and digital content optimisation.
* Ability to write engaging social media captions and reel scripts.
* Preferred Languages: English, Malayalam, Tamil, and Hindi. Additional Advantage: Telugu and Kannada knowledge
* Ability to understand brand tone and communicate ideas clearly.
* Familiarity with social media trends and content creation tools is desirable.
* Willingness to learn, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively with the marketing team.

Eligibility

* Graduates or candidates with relevant qualifications in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Literature, Marketing, or related fields are preferred. **Graduation is not a mandatory requirement if with relevant industrial experience.**
* Candidates with a strong writing portfolio may also apply.
* Experience: 0–2 years; freshers are welcome.

What We Offer

* Salary package of ₹12,000–₹20,000 per month, based on skills and experience.
* Opportunity to develop professional writing and digital marketing skills.
* Exposure to healthcare education, institutional branding, and student recruitment campaigns.
* A collaborative work environment with opportunities to showcase creativity.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with an updated résumé and writing samples or portfolio, if available.

**Walk-in Interview:** Monday, 28th,29th October 2026  
**Venue:** Wellcaza School of Health Sciences, Edappally Raghavan Pillai Road, Elamakkara, Kochi, Ernakulam District, Kerala – 682026.  
**Contact for location assistance:** 80899 20900

**Bring:** Updated résumé and samples of your writing, social media content, blogs, or copywriting work.

*If you love words, understand audiences, and can turn ideas into engaging content, we would love to hear from you!*

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
